title: subagent: DC metro station order Blue line

content:
I need to know the station order on the Washington DC Blue Line (the line that serves Smithsonian and Reagan National Airport). List all stations in order from one end to the other. Also list stations on the Red Line since Takoma is on that line. 

Specifically, I need to know:
- If you're at Smithsonian going toward Reagan National Airport, what direction are you heading?
- If you accidentally go in the opposite direction, what station would be closest to Cleveland Elementary School (Takoma)?
- What is the station order between Smithsonian and the branch that goes toward Reagan National Airport?

Please research this using web tools.
I'll research the DC Metro Blue Line and Red Line stations, focusing on the Smithsonian-Reagan National Airport connection and the Takoma area.

Washington DC Metro Red Line all stations order list Takoma
Cleveland Elementary School Takoma Park DC Metro station nearest
